instruction: Using only the standalone stem, independently free-generate exactly one most likely condition, exactly two priority nursing actions, and exactly two monitoring or evaluation parameters. stem: During general anesthesia with a volatile anesthetic, an adult client's end-tidal carbon dioxide rises rapidly from 38 to 72 mm Hg despite increased minute ventilation. The heart rate is 142/min, generalized muscle rigidity is present, and the core temperature has risen from 98.6 °F (37.0 °C) to 101.7 °F (38.7 °C) in 20 minutes. Complete the bow-tie.
